---
name: Compatibility report
about: Tell us how the port runs on your hardware (works, partly works, does not work)
---

**Result:** works / partly works / does not work

**Computer:** (paste the output of `./play.sh --nogui --diagnose`)

**What you tried and what happened:** (install finished? how long did it take? FPS? anything wrong on screen?)

**Safe mode:** did `./play.sh --nogui --safe` change anything? (yes / no / did not try)

**Files:** `./install.sh --report` zip or `local/logs/play-nxrt-*.log`. They contain no game data or keys.
